data.description_en:
## Product Type

Ready-to-eat spread 🥄
Net Weight: 220g ⚖️
Origin: Guangzhou, China 🌍



## Product Description


This is our take on chocolate hazelnut spread.
Mature. Clean. No shortcuts.
Roasted hazelnuts are blended into a rich paste, combined with cocoa and maple syrup for depth and balance.
Made with 81% hazelnuts for a bold, nut-forward flavor that tastes real and uncompromised.



## Why People Choose It

81% hazelnuts — nuts first, not sugar.
No palm oil. No dairy. No filler oils.
Deep chocolate flavor without being overly sweet or heavy.



## Ingredients

Hazelnut paste (81%), maple syrup, cocoa powder, salt, vanilla extract, sunflower lecithin, vitamin E oil





## Allergen Information

Contains: Tree nuts (hazelnuts)
May contain traces of: Other tree nuts, soy



## How To Enjoy

Spread on toast, warm bread, muffins, rice cakes, or fruit.
Mix into oats, smoothies, or baking recipes.
Or eat it directly — spoon, jar, no audience required.



## Storage & Shelf Life

Store at room temperature: Up to 2 months
Store refrigerated: Up to 6 months
Refrigerate after opening to maintain freshness and stability.



Serving Note 📌
Natural oil separation may occur due to the high nut content. Stir before use.
data.description_cn:
产品类型：即食抹酱 🥄

净含量：220g ⚖️

产地：中国广州 🌍





产品描述 🧾

这是我们对巧克力榛子酱的理解。

成熟。干净。不走捷径。

精选榛子烘烤后研磨成酱，加入可可粉和枫糖，带来层次与平衡。

81% 榛子含量，风味浓郁、坚果感十足，真实不妥协。





为什么人们会选它 🌰

81% 榛子 —— 坚果在前，不是糖。

不含棕榈油。不含乳制品。不用填充油脂。

有深度的巧克力风味，但不腻口。





配料表 🧾

榛子酱（81%）、枫糖、可可粉、盐、香草提取物、葵花籽卵磷脂、维生素E油





致敏原信息 ⚠️

含有：坚果（榛子）

可能含有微量：其他坚果、大豆





食用方式 🍽️

抹在吐司、热面包、松饼、米饼或水果上。

拌入燕麦、思慕雪或用于烘焙。

或者直接吃 —— 勺子、罐子，不需要观众。





贮存与保质期 🧊

常温保存：最多 2 个月

冷藏保存：最多 6 个月

开封后建议冷藏保存，以保持新鲜度与稳定性





营养信息（每 1 汤匙 / 约 20g）🧮

能量 114kcal

蛋白质 1.9g

脂肪 9.5g

– 饱和脂肪 0.9g

碳水化合物 6.0g

– 糖 4.5g

膳食纤维 1.3g

盐 0.13g





食用提示 📌

植物性巧克力榛子酱 🌿

高坚果含量，出现天然油脂分离属正常现象，食用前搅拌
